decision: Wave52 is process-valid and rejects horizon 4 as the fixed deployment-feasible operating point: on 128 test episodes, current-buffer GAR normalized edit-distance improvement falls from 0.05048 to 0.00611 for checkpoint seed 0 and from 0.04876 to 0.01782 for seed 1 between horizons 2 and 4, while horizon 5 is negative for both (-0.03369 and -0.01492). The fourth and fifth selected edits have negative mean true advantage on both checkpoints, and GAR remains far above the matched target-free random control. Evaluate the missing horizon 3 at the identical 128-episode, 256-candidate protocol. Adopt horizon 2 as the fixed operating point if horizon 3 fails to improve on horizon 2 for both checkpoints or is non-positive for either; adopt horizon 3 only if it is positive and exceeds horizon 2 on both checkpoints. Otherwise retain horizon 2 conservatively and treat the boundary as checkpoint-dependent. Candidate generation and GAR selection remain deployment-feasible and target-free; terminal targets are used only for test metrics.
